authority.autodesk_dictionary: https://help.autodesk.com/cloudhelp/2018/ENU/OARXMAC-RefGuide/files/OREFMAC-AcDbDictionary.html: AcDbDictionary keys are case-insensitive and entries have unique objects.

problem: The pending DWG Named Objects Dictionary indexed names with case-sensitive bytes, so an already registered aCaD_PlotStyleName did not prevent ACAD_PLOTSTYLENAME with a different child. A second unrelated NOD key could also alias the plotstyle target handle. Both leave an ambiguous default plotstyle root.
baseline_probe: Against the prior writer source blob 8e6ab82d8392152794d75d7d2584d36b2e4f0528, direct registration produced first=1 duplicate=1 alias=1; the focused test executable exited 1. The guarded writer produced first=1 duplicate=0 alias=0 and the focused test passed.
scope: Only the ASCII-reserved ACAD_PLOTSTYLENAME key is compared with locale-independent ASCII folding. Admission rejects a second case variant, a DRW::NoHandle target and any NOD alias of that specific target in either registration order. Existing GROUP/NOD identity collision checks remain active. The emitted key keeps the caller's original spelling. Unrelated NOD names retain their existing admission/collation behavior, including differently cased names; Unicode dictionary collation is not implemented or claimed.
rollback: A rejected candidate is checked before reservation or pending-list mutation. The derived pending index is revalidated with the same narrow rules after a public-transaction rollback; a new spelling/target can then be registered on the same low-level writer. Facade duplicate rejection leaves an existing output untouched, and a corrected retry through the same dwgRW succeeds.
caller_compatibility: Tests confirm both an early root registration from writeDwgClasses and a late root registration from writeLTypes before deferred OBJECTS still work; class registration remains early in both. The graph is caller-supplied and no new default graph is synthesized.

tests.result: PASS for AC1015, AC1018, AC1021, AC1024, AC1027 and AC1032: mixed-case collision, NOD target aliases in both orders, GROUP handle collision in both orders, no-handle, public checkpoint rollback/retry, distinct unrelated names, facade atomic failure and same-writer retry, early/late NOD registration and typed root/dictionary/default/placeholder readback.
tests.independent: LibreDWG 0.14 independently decoded the exact mixed-case NOD key, its dictionary target, Normal entry/default handle and placeholder presence in all six scratch outputs. The generated writer HEADER still does not bind this caller-supplied plotstyle dictionary; these are admission and object readback controls, not complete plotstyle graph support.

remaining: Default graph synthesis remains open: caller NOD registration may happen after HEADER/CLASSES emission, so synthesizing early would preempt a valid late caller. Resolve that lifecycle explicitly; then prove early class admission, identity allocation, header and default-layer binding, graph completeness, caller overrides, rollback/retry and native/independent output. No ODA acceptance or complete DWG plotstyle support is claimed. No DWG/DXF fixtures were committed.
